comparison.objective: Arrange four drift-fence arms tightly against a pitfall trap; numeric fit criteria are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part placement and boundary fitting, without precision tool impact or small-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Four fence arms contact the trap as intended; detailed thresholds are unspecified, with no fracture, retained insert, or debris-containment requirement.
comparison.reason: Tests multi-part spatial arrangement rather than bimanual hammer-and-mandrel fracture control.
